name: wolf_rider
description: a Wolf Rider, a green goblin with big pointed ears in a steel helmet and an orange tunic, a round wooden shield with a steel boss on his RIGHT arm and a steel-tipped wooden spear in his LEFT hand, riding a large grey-brown wolf with a cream muzzle and chest, yellow eyes, snarling white fangs in a red mouth, dark paws and a bushy tail
hands: the spear stays in the goblin's left hand on the screen-right side and the round shield on his right arm on the screen-left side; the wolf fights with its fanged jaws

strike.3: swing: the goblin drives the spear forward, its point toward the lower-right, the round shield held at his side; the wolf springs forward toward the lower-right, forelegs reaching off the ground, its fanged jaws opening; both face the lower-right
strike.4: contact: the goblin leans far forward over the wolf's neck with his weapon arm fully extended, the spear thrust out along a line to the lower-right, its point the farthest point of the figure; the wolf lunges far forward toward the lower-right, low, its neck stretched out and its fanged jaws snapping wide open, hind legs driving; both face the lower-right
strike.5: follow-through: the goblin holds the thrust, the point of the spear dipping a little; the wolf holds the lunge, front paws planted ahead, jaws still open in a snarl; both face the lower-right
